evals.name: Multi-Stage Dockerfile with Non-Root Hardening
evals.prompt: Author a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Node.js TypeScript application that installs dependencies using pnpm frozen lockfile, prunes dev dependencies, creates an unprivileged user, and executes as non-root.
evals.expected_output: Creates Dockerfile with builder stage compiling app, and production stage copying artifacts to appuser non-root account.
assertions: Defines separate builder and production runtime stages in Dockerfile
Installs dependencies using deterministic pnpm frozen lockfile command
Creates custom non-root system group and user with explicit UID
Declares USER instruction to prevent root container execution in production

evals.name: 10-Step Mandatory CI Pull Request Quality Gate
evals.prompt: Configure a GitHub Actions CI workflow covering all 10 mandatory steps: lint, format, typecheck, unit tests, integration tests, dependency audit, secret scan, Docker build, Trivy scan, and registry push.
evals.expected_output: Defines .github/workflows/ci.yml running 10 quality gates, blocking PR on failures, and pushing only on main merge.
assertions: Configures automated CI trigger on pull requests targeting the main branch
Executes lint, format, typecheck, unit, and integration test validation gates
Integrates SAST dependency auditing and GitLeaks secret scanning
Restricts container registry push step strictly to merged commits on main branch

evals.name: Trivy Container Vulnerability Scanning & Immutable Versioning
evals.prompt: Implement automated container vulnerability scanning with Trivy in CI, failing the build on critical CVEs, and tagging images with immutable Git commit SHAs instead of latest.
evals.expected_output: Adds Trivy step with exit-code 1 on CRITICAL/HIGH, and configures docker build with github.sha tag.
assertions: Integrates Trivy vulnerability scanner targeting built container images
Sets exit code 1 to block pipeline on unpatched CRITICAL or HIGH severity CVEs
Tags container images with immutable Git commit SHA identifiers
Prohibits using the mutable latest tag for production container images
